additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422261-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000887] Charger showing errorcodes CRM:02698000099
additional_info.body:
Update – 25/06
Following a new on-site visit, it was observed that charging starts only 1 time out of 2. The process gets stuck at the "Connection" state, preventing proper session initiation.
The issue remains intermittent and continues to generate significant connection interval errors. Further analysis of logs is needed to determine the root cause.
Please keep me informed once the log extraction has been completed.
Best regards,
Florian
